visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Base Case Fires Too Early
visualizerParams.problemDescription: abc has 6 permutations, but the program prints only 3 of them.

solution.explanation: A permutation is complete only when every position has been fixed, which is when start reaches the last index n - 1. Printing at n - 2 stops one level too early and never arranges the last two letters.
